headline: The A-148 amendment is landed in the vocabulary and the engine: one discriminated conflict payload, the same-layer stale-columns shape detected at source, the sentence produced in ONE place, the superseded 2019-51/repealed test replaced by the A-148 fixture and both A-148 falsifiers. Suites green. The sentence cannot yet be EMITTED by a deployed surface because @empressaio/atom-contract 1.36.0 is not on npm (publish gated on an operator OTP).

commits.base: 2132cd2 (the wave-6 commit the dispatch told me to amend, left intact on feat/p154-conflict-row-vocab)
commits.content: 1.36.0 — `setbackConflictNote` gains the `shape` discriminator: `"second-source"` (two dated instruments, unchanged semantics) and `"stale-numeric-columns"` (A-148). CHANGELOG 1.36.0 entry added, 1.35.0 marked superseded in part, package.json/package-lock 1.36.0.
commits.pr: opened by this lane (was pushed with NO PR: a limbo branch)
commits.publish: NOT published — `npm publish` needs a one-time password this lane cannot supply

commits.whyDraft: the stale-columns arm needs @empressaio/atom-contract >= 1.36.0; deps stay ^1.35.0 so a caret install picks it up once the gated publish lands. Marked draft so nothing merges a surface whose sentence cannot be printed.

theOneSentence.exact: The city's One Click card shows 25/5/25 from unrefreshed numeric columns of its zoning layer; the same layer's text and Ordinance 2026-06 say 30/10/30/20 (confirmed with the City of Bastrop 2026-09-14)
theOneSentence.vocabularyOutput: VERIFIED literally, by invoking the module itself in the contract worktree (`npx tsx -e` on `src/display/wire.ts` with the A-148 inputs): output is the string above, character for character.
theOneSentence.enginePayload: VERIFIED by test — `getSetbackTableForZoning('bastrop-development-code','SF-1',{bastropPerParcelRecord})` returns `kind: "conflict"` with `note` deep-equal to {shape: stale-numeric-columns, secondSourceLabel: One Click card, numeric 25/5/25, text 30/10/30/20, ordinance 2026-06, confirmedWith the City of Bastrop, confirmedOn 2026-09-14}.
theOneSentence.panel: NOT PRODUCED — `hauska-map`'s PE card has no conflict slot today (`pe-bastrop-per-parcel-setback.ts` says so in its own header: engine's disclosure metadata 'is not reproduced here'), so this face needs the payload ported into PE's codified-setback type first. Not in this diff; left in `leave_behind`.
theOneSentence.getSmartSite: NOT PRODUCED — `get_smart_site` reads the same payload the PDF does (engine-core site-model), so it inherits the blocked contract version below; not measured in a deployed environment.
theOneSentence.pdf: NOT PRODUCED — engine-core's site plan/PDF calls `conflictNote(...)` (verified wired), but the installed contract is 1.35.0, which has no stale-columns arm.

failClosedGuard.what: the ONE place the payload becomes the sentence. It casts to whichever contract version is installed AND, for the stale-columns shape, checks that the returned sentence actually names the numeric and text readings the payload carries. If it does not (a 1.35.x install would print '...shows undefined/undefined/undefined...'), it THROWS rather than let a surface print a conflict claim that does not state its numbers.
failClosedGuard.why: a wrong sentence on a conflict row is worse than a failed render: the row exists to state both claims out loud.

packages/adapters/src/local/setbacks/bastrop-conflict-a148.ts (new) — the A-148 facts: both layer URLs, the three numeric shortcut columns, the current ordinance 2026-06, its effective date 2026-04-14, the 2026-09-14 city confirmation

falsifiers.hypothesis: if the note still says the One Click values cite Ordinance 2019-51 and that it was repealed, the amendment did not land
falsifiers.observed: NOT OBSERVED. The stale arm's payload has no `citation` and no `repealedByEffectiveDate` member at all (asserted structurally), and the row's serialized disclosure matches neither /2019-51/ nor /repealed/i. The superseded test that asserted the old sentence was deleted, not weakened.

falsifiers.hypothesis: if the note prints a corner value for 48021:34049, it read a column that does not exist
falsifiers.observed: NOT OBSERVED. `numeric` has exactly {front, side, rear} — asserted — and the sentence prints 25/5/25.

falsifiers.hypothesis: the detector fires on values that do not disagree
falsifiers.observed: NOT OBSERVED. The same row with numeric columns 30/10/30 (agreeing with its text) yields `kind: "table"` and no disclosure on the row.

falsifiers.hypothesis: the vocabulary prints something other than the required sentence
falsifiers.observed: NOT OBSERVED. Direct invocation of the 1.36.0 module returns the required sentence character for character (see theOneSentence.vocabularyOutput).

blockers: @empressaio/atom-contract 1.36.0 is not published (operator OTP). Until it is, no deployed surface can print the A-148 arm; the engine refuses to print a substitute.
the panel face (hauska-map) has no slot for the conflict payload yet.

no deployment was performed by this lane: no deploy credentials were found in-lane, and deploying a surface that cannot render its sentence would be worse than not deploying. Reported, not skipped silently.
